title: A module ask is interviewed, then drafted as "Your workflow" in the person's words

steps.remove_module: Car Wash Site Screener — Austin, gates-first

steps.say: I want help picking car wash sites to open
steps.reply: I've flagged this as a question on your Home card — the earlier "M0/M1 built and passing" claims in this chat don't match what's actually in your tables, since the whole module was deleted today before anything landed. Let me know which way you want to go and I'll pick it up from there.

steps.say: It's for me, to decide which sites to pursue and brief my investors. Sites come from brokers by email. Today I check households within 3 miles, density, drive-time population, the traffic on the road and at the main intersection, then I score fourteen things like visibility and access from 1 to 10 with a note each, and write a memo to investors. Thresholds: 45,000 households, 30,000 cars a day. Start with Austin. Go ahead and write it up.
steps.reply:
I've logged two questions on your Home card before drafting this:

1. **The 14 scoring factors** — you named visibility and access; I need the other twelve (a file, a quick list in chat, or let me propose a car-wash-specific set for you to correct).
2. **How broker site emails reach you** — one or two known senders, or mixed senders in your general inbox.

steps.say: Add a minimum lot size of 0.8 acres as one of the checks.
steps.reply:
Got it — noted: minimum lot size of 0.8 acres as a gate alongside the 45,000 households and 30,000 cars/day thresholds.

That still leaves the two open questions before I can draft the workflow page: the other twelve scoring factors, and how the broker emails reach you (specific senders vs. general inbox). Whenever you've got those, I'll put the page together.
